data.body:
[P2] Recognize waits that survive an intermediate resume

A valid execution can start a wait in request A, return PENDING, resume as B for another operation's retry, return PENDING again, and finally resume as C when the original wait completes. This matcher rejects the wait against A because B is the first candidate and completion occurs later; it rejects it against B because the wait started before B. Consequently, `durableWaitObserved` and `suspensionCheckpointMatches` become false despite a genuine public suspension. Carry outstanding waits across invocations and associate their completion with the appropriate resume. Add a three-invocation regression covering this sequence.
